title: Concept: npm publish token committed in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Anyone with repository read access can publish as the token's owner, and the token keeps working until it is rotated by hand.
risk: Anyone with repository read access can publish as the token's owner, and the token keeps working until it is rotated by hand.
